author: /root/c20_windows_author

files.on_block:
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_tag:
        description: Testing candidate tag to verify
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, testing, release ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, testing, release ]

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: Platform to build once and upload to internal testing
        required: true
        default: android
        type: choice
        options:
          - android
          - ios
          - both
      confirmation:
        description: candidate:<platform>:<version>:<build>
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: Platform whose exact internal build should be promoted
        required: true
        default: android
        type: choice
        options:
          - android
          - ios
          - both
      candidate_run_id:
        description: Successful candidate workflow run ID
        required: true
        type: string
      confirmation:
        description: external-testing:<platform>:<version>:<build>
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: Platform to validate
        required: true
        default: android
        type: choice
        options:
          - android
          - ios
          - both

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        required: true
        type: string
      channel:
        required: true
        type: string
      operation:
        required: true
        type: string
      version:
        required: true
        type: string
      build_number:
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_tag:
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      candidate_commit:
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      testflight_distribution:
        required: false
        default: email-list
        type: string
      production_confirmation:
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      testing_confirmation:
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      review_withdrawal_confirmation:
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      pipeline_lock_held:
        description: The protected caller already holds the repository-wide release-pipeline lock
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: Platform to build and upload
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - both
          - android
          - ios
      channel:
        description: Store destination
        required: true
        default: internal
        type: choice
        options:
          - internal
          - external
          - production
      operation:
        description: Upload a new internal binary or promote the exact existing build
        required: true
        default: upload
        type: choice
        options:
          - upload
          - promote
          - store-assets
      version:
        description: Exact marketing version; blank uses version.properties
        required: false
        type: string
      build_number:
        description: Exact committed Store build number from version.properties
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_tag:
        description: Required readiness-approved candidate tag for production
        required: false
        type: string
      testflight_distribution:
        description: External iOS invitation method
        required: true
        default: email-list
        type: choice
        options:
          - email-list
      production_confirmation:
        description: Type I_APPROVE_PRODUCTION only for a production upload
        required: false
        type: string
      testing_confirmation:
        description: Type I_CONFIRM_REQUIRED_TESTING_COMPLETED only after required store testing is complete
        required: false
        type: string
      review_withdrawal_confirmation:
        description: Type I_APPROVE_REVIEW_WITHDRAWAL to withdraw review and replace iOS store assets
        required: false
        type: string

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
      - 'site/**'
      - 'scripts/build-public-site.rb'
      - 'iosApp/iosApp/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-1024.png'
  workflow_dispatch:

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirmation:
        description: Type VERIFY_ONLY_NO_UPLOAD to run the disposable-edit check
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_tag:
        description: Readiness-approved candidate tag
        required: true
        type: string
      platform:
        description: Store to submit; choose one when retrying a partial failure
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - both
          - android
          - ios
      authorization_run_id:
        description: Successful Request Mobile Production Release run ID
        required: true
        type: string
      authorization_sha:
        description: Exact protected-main SHA that authorized this child run
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_tag:
        description: Readiness-approved candidate tag to sign without publishing
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_tag:
        description: Production candidate whose stores are live
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_tag:
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_tag:
        description: Readiness-approved mobile candidate tag
        required: true
        type: string
      platform:
        description: Store to promote; choose one only when retrying a partial failure
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - both
          - android
          - ios
      confirmation:
        description: Type I_APPROVE_MOBILE_PRODUCTION
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  push:
    branches: [ testing ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      resume_existing_internal_uploads:
        description: Reuse attested internal receipts instead of uploading Android/iOS again
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: false
      resume_confirmation:
        description: Required as resume:<version>:<build> when resuming existing internal uploads
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
